title: Once-Weekly Somapacitan as an Alternative Management of Growth Hormone Deficiency in Prepubertal Children: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trial.
authors: Tsurayya G, Nazhifah CA, Pirwanja MR, Zulfa PO, Tatroman MRR, Fakri F, Iqhrammullah M.

Forest plot of overall adverse events of Somapacitan versus Norditropin. Size of the blue box indicates the study weight. The black diamond indicates the value for the total estimates.
